back: Very strong N≡N bond (944 kJ mol⁻¹) → high activation energy; non-polar molecule → no sites for attack.
NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (weak base, equilibrium to the left).
Dative bond from N lone pair to H⁺; tetrahedral, 109.5°; all four N–H bonds identical.
NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ → NH₃ + H₂O on warming: an acid-base reaction.
Warm with NaOH(aq): gas turns damp red litmus blue (ammonia).
Heat NH₄Cl with Ca(OH)₂; dry with CaO; collect by upward delivery (less dense than air).
Lightning (N₂ + O₂ → 2NO), bacteria in legume root nodules, and the Haber process.

front: Do not mix ammonium fertiliser with lime
back: OH⁻ from lime displaces NH₃, so nitrogen is lost as ammonia gas.
